question: Who among the following is the exponent of mandolin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**U Srinivas**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• U. Srinivas **was a renowned mandolin virtuoso in Carnatic music.**
 
• He** is credited with popularizing the mandolin,** a Western instrument, in Indian classical music.
 
• Known as the "**Mandolin Maestro," Srinivas started performing at a very young age and gained international fame for his in**novative and soulful performances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
